routing_description: Engine shaking, rough idle, unusual engine sounds or engine warning observations.
planner_instructions: Gather engine symptoms and operating-state history. Keep owner-reported symptoms distinct from measurements and cite the original evidence IDs. Compare observations in similar operating states; use recent history for a bounded view and the full observations when timing matters. Missing RPM, vibration or warning data is an information gap, not evidence of normal operation. Do not infer a specific failed component from a symptom alone.
